content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure represents a fundamental shift in how digital creators can operate online. By utilizing a combination of free tools and services, creators can build fully functional online stores that are independent of traditional payment processors. This is particularly crucial in regions where platforms like Stripe operate in only 46 out of 195 countries, leaving many creators without reliable options. The ability to sell digital products without being dependent on these restricted services not only empowers creators but also ensures they have full control over their sales and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be robust and efficient. It typically involves a combination of platforms such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. With NOWPayments facilitating automatic crypto payment processing, transactions are verified on-chain, minimizing fees and maximizing efficiency. This decentralized setup ensures that creators maintain ownership of their products and data, eliminating the risk of account suspensions or arbitrary holds on funds, which can last up to 180 days with platforms like PayPal.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically built for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted. It addresses the unique challenges faced by creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, who often struggle to monetize their digital products effectively. By providing a sovereign solution, COREMERCH enables these creators to sell ebooks, plugins, courses, and other digital products without the fear of payment failures or account restrictions. This approach fosters a more inclusive digital economy, allowing creators from all backgrounds to thrive.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to sell without restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of this infrastructure relies on various components working in harmony. For instance, Cloudflare Pages allows creators to host their online stores at no cost, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend processes necessary for order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets manage order data, ensuring that creators have easy access to their sales information. With file delivery managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and NOWPayments handling the crypto transactions, the entire system is designed to be seamless, efficient, and user-friendly. Each component plays a crucial role in enabling creators to operate independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, configure your order management through Supabase or Google Sheets. Ensure you have a reliable file delivery mechanism, such as Google Drive. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept payments without traditional processor constraints. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes all necessary tools and configurations for a smooth deployment.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can still sell digital products by utilizing sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach allows you to build an independent online store using free tools and services, enabling seamless transactions without reliance on restricted payment processors. With solutions like NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrency payments directly.
Full ownership of sales data ensures creators retain control and independence.

For creators searching for alternatives to platforms like Gumroad and Paddle, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a viable solution. Explore the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a comprehensive setup that includes everything needed to launch your online store. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
